description:
The Corvian Empire is the dominant power on the continent of Mythros. At the heart of the Corvian Empire lies the nation of Corvus itself, with its resplendent capital, Orta.

The server itself, however, is not a single state, but rather a vast, entirely custom-designed world featuring many nations, tribes, and peoples. In addition to a well-crafted, fully explorable world, the server features custom mods and textures that make food, equipment, transportation, and architecture significantly more diverse and give every possible culture its own unique aesthetic.

This announcement, meanwhile, is intended exclusively for those interested in becoming Corvian citizens. With an aesthetic reminiscent of the early Roman Empire, the Corvian Empire is the most organized and highly developed state in the world. It boasts both an active, well-trained military which regularly organizes events and training exercises, defending Corvus against barbarian tribes, and an efficient civil administration, a Senate, and well-thought-out laws.

While every citizen begins as a prole, thanks to the Empire’s protection and the stable economy of Corvus and its provinces, every citizen has the opportunity to rise the social ladder until they one day may own a splendid villa in Orta, hold a leadership position in the military, are part of the honorable Senate, or run a thriving commercial enterprise.

Note: Currently, the Corvian state is primarily looking for talented architects, dedicated civil servants, and merchants. 

All additional information, including the application process, can be found on the Discord server. While we speak English, our players come from all time zones.
